_comment: Digitizing config for TN D-6853 Fig 2 (view at entry, Apollo 11), CM window view, 100° field. bodies: approxPx snaps to the nearest blob within 20 px; manualPx is used as-is for glyphs touching lines. outlineVerticesPx: corners of the commander's window outlines (left and right eye), read on 3× gridded zooms (scripts/zoom-grid.ts).

Altair.note: Touches the frame's inset band (x = −47°); read by hand on a 12× zoom.

Mars.note: The middle of three dots above the label, touching a leader line; read on an 8× zoom (the nearest-blob snap caught a letter).

Antares.note: Label placement is ambiguous; the dot is the one nearest the position predicted by the stars-only fit of the unambiguous labels.
